test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All envelopes are letters.

2. No letter is a paper.

3. Some papers are notebook.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some papers are envelopes.

II. All notebooks can never be letters.

III. Some notebooks are envelopes.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96b1f78eaed3433c591b05b84a5ca49179c60c63c081ea92a2b035ca50220ed0.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some papers are envelopes → Does not follow (As all envelopes are letters and no letter is a paper. As no direct relation is given between paper and envelopes, therefore it is false)

II. All notebooks can never be letters → Follow (As no letter is a paper and some papers are notebook. As no letter is paper which has some part common with notebooks, therefore all notebooks cannot be letters.)

III. Some notebooks are envelopes → Does not follow (As all envelopes are letters, no letter is a paper and some papers are notebook. As no direct relation is given between notebooks and envelopes, therefore it is false)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
